item.description:
Sukoon 1.6.1 — a redesigned day timeline.

  • Every prayer is labeled again — 1.6 could hide Maghrib's name on the timeline; sorry about that.
  • Five evenly-spaced stations — Fajr through Isha each get equal room, in Arabic and English alike, so labels never crowd or overlap. The sun still tracks real time as it travels toward the next prayer.

Sukoon 1.6 — location accuracy and first-run fixes, straight from user feedback.

  • City search loads as you type — no more pressing Return and wondering; the magnifier works too.
  • Exact city out of the box — first-run setup now uses on-device Location Services (with your permission), so Dubai no longer shows up as Abu Dhabi. When the approximate mode is in use, Sukoon says so and points to the fix.
  • The onboarding Allow button always works — if macOS already blocked notifications, it now takes you straight to System Settings with clear steps instead of doing nothing.
  • Travel suggestions as notifications — when your country's prayer-time convention differs, you'll know without opening the popover.
  • Cleaner Arabic — no more duplicated English + Arabic prayer names when the app is in Arabic, and timeline labels no longer overlap on short evenings.

Sukoon 1.5 — a polish release from a full UI/UX audit. 31 fixes.

  • Accent colors now work — pick any of the six accents and the whole app follows, in light and dark.
  • The adhan panel no longer steals your typing focus — it appears quietly without switching apps.
  • Honest qibla — clear "° from North" bearing with a practical hint, no fake compass claims.
  • VoiceOver & keyboard access for all controls, better small-text contrast, larger click targets.
  • 12/24-hour clock follows your macOS setting, everywhere including widgets.
  • Popover density setting works, prayer names localized in the main list, save cities with a star, download retry, undo-aware prayer logging, dark-mode fixes, persistent tasbih, and more.

Sukoon 1.4 — the biggest update yet, and the first notarized release (no more security warnings on install).

  • Meeting-aware adhan — silences itself when your microphone is in use, so the adhan never interrupts a call.
  • Mark prayed from the notification — log a prayer without opening anything.
  • Tap-to-log on widgets — check off prayers right on the widget.
  • After-adhan dua — the panel lingers with the dua between adhan and iqama.
  • Travel mode — suggests the locally-used calculation method when you change country.
  • Precise location (opt-in) — exact times via Location Services; your location never leaves your Mac.
  • Shortcuts & Siri — Next Prayer, Log Prayer, and automation recipes.
  • Four new languages — اردو, Türkçe, Bahasa Indonesia, Français.
  • Year in review — yearly stats with a shareable card, plus live adhan phrase tracking, offline fallback, and better first-run screens.
Sukoon 1.3 — Arabic widget faces (widgets now follow the app language), plus automatic silent updates via Sparkle.
